name: WhatsApp: every minute (no agent)
command: WA="$(cat .wa-bin 2>/dev/null)"; [ -x "$WA/wa-scope" ] || WA="$(cat "$HOME/.wa-inbox/bin-path" 2>/dev/null)"; [ -x "$WA/wa-scope" ] || [ -z "$APPDATA" ] || WA="$(cat "$APPDATA/wa-inbox/bin-path" 2>/dev/null)"; [ -x "$WA/wa-scope" ] || { echo "wa-scope not found: neither .wa-bin in $PWD nor bin-path in ~/.wa-inbox or %APPDATA%/wa-inbox names an executable wa-scope; enable the plugin in Orca so it writes them" >&2; exit 1; }; "$WA/wa-scope" tick --json
